chunks: Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim asked Abā ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام about an enclosure between two houses.
So he mentioned: "That ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled that it belongs to the owner of the house on whose side the boundary rope is."

key_terms.الْقِمَاطُ: the boundary rope or marker indicating side or attachment
key_terms.حَظِيرَةٍ: an enclosure or fenced area under dispute
key_terms.دَارَيْنِ: two houses between which the enclosure was located
key_terms.قَضَى: he gave judgment or ruled judicially
key_terms.لِصَاحِبِ الدَّارِ: for the owner of the house

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام judge ownership of an enclosure between two houses?
ai.summary: This hadith records a judicial ruling regarding an enclosure located between two houses. Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام judged ownership in favor of the householder on whose side the boundary marker or rope was found, showing a practical principle in resolving property disputes.
